items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: I played with Robichaux for 16 long years. 16 years. John Robichaux?

ctx.x: Only the words. Only the words. Only the words. Yes. Yeah, and...

Rika was trying to get A La Ba for him, but he was too late. Mm-hmm. He was too late. Who was it? Rika? Rika. Rikard Alexis, huh? Oh. Rikard Alexis. Oh, I see. I was going to ask about a few of the other old bands that you played with, to check some of those on a list here. Did you ever play with the Excelsior brass? Oh, no. The Excelsior and the Onward brass band. Excelsior and the Onward. Who was the leader of the Excelsior when you were there? Manuel Pérez. They only used one clarinet in those days. One…
Moret. Yes. That was his first band, wasn't it?
